s: Dine birkat hashshanim ubo h' seipim: "birkat hashshanim" tzarik lishol bah matar bimot haggeshamim. Umippene ma qabeu hashsheela be"birkat hashshanim", mittok shehi parnasa qebauha bebirkat parnasa. Umatchilin lishol beeretz yisrael millel z' bemarcheshvan, lepi shehi eretz harim utzerika ligshamim miyyad achar hechag. Vehaya rauy lishol bah miyyad achar hechag ella sheicharu hashsheela t"v yamim achar hechag, kede sheyyaggia haacharon shebbeyisrael sheala laregel lebeto linhar perat, shehu meqom yishshub hayyoter rachoq mirushalayim, velo yatzerennu haggeshem (veap leachar hachurban hayu mitassepim gam ken mikkol hassebibot birushalayim laregel, kemo sheosim gam hayyom, lepikak lo bittelu taqqanat chakamim shettiqqenu hashsheela beeretz yisrael bez' bemarcheshvan). Ubebabel vekayyotze bah sheenah eretz harim keeretz yisrael veen tzarik laggeshamim miyyad achar hechag — matchilin belel s' achar tequpat tishre, veyom hattequpa veyom hashsheela hem biklal has', nimtza leolam b' yamim ben hattequpa lashsheela, sheim hattequpa beyom a' — hashsheela hi belel d'. Ves' yom ellu en monin otam meet leet, ella apillu nopla hattequpa bayyom matchilin lishol belel s' miyyom zeh. Veanu minhagenu kibne babel bekol maqom. Veyesh shettamehu vechalequ al zeh, ap sheanu holekim achare chakme babel bekol maqom veosim kemotam bemaqom shennechlequ chakme babel vechakme eretz yisrael mippene shettalmud babli hu iqqar, zehu bidbar issur vehetter vechiyyub upetor vetuma vetohora, abal bedabar hattaluy betzorek hashshaa veen bo shinnuy laabor al dibre tora — rauy lelek achar hashshanim vehammeqomot vehazzeman, shebbabel shokenet al mayim rabbim veen tzarik laggeshamim ad s' lattequpa, o haya zeman hazzera meuchar bebabel, abal baaratzot ellu shezzeman hazzera hu mechatzi tishre veelak haddabar yadua sheim lo yaredu geshamim miyyad achar hazzera shehu mitqalqel shehaopot vehaakbarim yokluhu kullo — lamma lo naaseh kibne eretz yisrael sheshshoalin haggeshamim bez' bemarcheshvan, ki bedabar zeh en machaloqet ben bene babel uben bene eretz yisrael, sheyyittenu ellu taam ledibrehem sherauy laasot kak veellu notenim taam sherauy laasot kemotan, ella shebbebabel hayu osim kepi hatztzarik lahem ubeeretz yisrael kepi hatztzarik lahem, veken bekol eretz shehi rachabat yadayim rauy laasot bah kepi hatztzorek lekullah, apillu lishol geshamim bimot hachamma im tzerikim lekullah. Abal meqomot hatztzerikim geshamim bimot hachamma veenam niqraim eretz bipne atzmah — kichidim dami, veshoalin be"shomea tepilla", shehu meqom sheelat kol tzerakayv shel adam kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qy"t. Abal be"birkat hashshanim" en rashshay leshannot matbea hatztzibbur mippene tzorek atzman velishol matar bizman shehu mazziq lerob haolam. Veim tau veshaalu bebirkat hashshanim — machazirin otam kemo yachid hattoeh. Vegam be"shomea tepilla" en shoalin ella kol yachid leatzmo bitpillat lachash, abal en omerim "veten tal umatar" bitpillat hatztzibbur shehi chazarat hashsheliach tzibbur, ella meratztzin lepanayv yitbarak betaanit ubislichot ubemizmorim upesuqim shel matar, veen hashsheliach tzibbur meshanneh mimmatbea hatztzibbur lomar beperush "veten tal umatar" be"shomea tepilla". Uleinyan halaka lo nitqabbela sebara zo, shekkebar nahagu meolam bekol teputzot yisrael shebbechutz laaretz lelek achar bene babel bazeh. Ulepi zeh im eretz achat tzerika ligshamim bimot hachamma, apillu hi rachabat yadayim kemo ashkena"z biklalah o separa"d biklalah, vaapillu aratzot rabbot rachabot yadayim — kichidim hem ub"shomea tepilla". Umikkol maqom im eretz achat kullah tzerika lematar bimot hachamma vetaa bah hayyachid veshaal matar be"birkat hashshanim" — yakol lismok al sebara zo bediabad, veeno mechuyyab lachazor ella im rotzeh lachazor ulehitpallel betorat nedaba (veen tzarik lechaddesh bah dabar kevan shemmitpallel al hassapeq, kemo shennitbaer besiman q"z veq"ch). Vehu haddin im baaratzot ellu taa hayyachid veshaal matar miz' bemarcheshvan veelak — eno mechuyyab lachazor:

Ad matay shoalin haggeshamim? Ad tepillat hammincha shel ereb yom tob harishon shel pesach, umishsham veelak poseqin lishol kemo shepposeqin lehazkir. Vaapillu qodem shepposeqin lehazkir, kegon shettaa vehitchil belel yom tob tepillat chol venizkar achar shehitchil "birkat hashshanim", shehu tzarik ligmor otah beraka kemo sheyyitbaer besiman rs"ch — lo yomar bah "veten tal umatar", shehare ap lehazkir haya min haddin lehapsiq belel yom tob ella sheecharu ad musap mishshum sheen kol haam metzuyim bebet hakkeneset ballayla veyihyu aguddot aguddot kemo shennitbaer besiman qy"d, im ken bishela sheen hatztzibbur shoalim — ap hu lo yishol. Veken im hashsheela hi belel shabbat vetaa yachid vehitpallel shel chol — lo yishal, kevan shehatztzibbur lo hitchilu adayin, shehayyachid nigrar achar hatztzibbur bekol maqom:

Veim shaal matar achar yom tob harishon shel pesach, ben shennizkar qodem siyyum habberaka ben shennizkar achar kak — tzarik lachazor lerosh habberaka, mittaam shennitbaer besiman qy"d. Veim lo nizkar ad leachar chatimot berakot acherot — tzarik lachazor lerosh "birkat hashshanim" velomar mishsham veelak kol habberakot al hasseder, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qy"t:

Im lo shaal matar bimot haggeshamim — machazirin oto apillu im shaal tal, shehashsheela enah doma lahazkara, shekkeshehizkir tal bimqom geshem en machazirin oto, lepi shehazkara hu siddur shibcho shel maqom vehoradat hattal hi gam ken shebach lo kemo horadat haggeshem kemo shennitbaer besiman qy"d, abal bishela tzarik lishol kol dabar hammebio lide beraka hen tal hen geshem, veen tal oleh bimqom geshem. Umikkol maqom, im lo shaal tal — en machazirin oto, sheshsheelat hattal eno ella minhag, shechakamim lo chiyyebu kelal betal lo bishela velo behazkara, mittaam shennitbaer sham:

Im lo shaal matar venizkar qodem shehitchil "teqa beshopar" — shoalo sham, venechshab keillu shoalo betok "birkat hashshanim" kemo shennitbaer besiman qy"d. Veim nizkar achar shehitchil "teqa beshopar" qodem "shomea tepilla" — en machazirin oto, veshoel be"shomea tepilla", mah sheen ken bahazkara shehu shebach veen lah inyan be"shomea tepilla". Veim hu sharuy betaanit vetzarik lomar "anenu" be"shomea tepilla" — yomar "veten tal umatar" qodem "anenu", shehashsheela chamura me"anenu" sheim lo amarah kelal machazirin oto, mah sheen ken ba"anenu", lekak rauy lehaqdimah. Veim nizkar achar chatimat "shomea tepilla" qodem shehitchil "retzeh" — omer "veten tal umatar" veachar kak matchil "retzeh", venechshab keillu shoalo be"shomea tepilla". Veim lo nizkar ad leachar shehitchil "retzeh", im lo aqar raglayv — chozer le"birkat hashshanim". Veim aqar raglayv — chozer lerosh hattepilla. Veim hishlim tepillato veeno ragil lomar tachanunim achar tepillato, ap al pi shello aqar raglayv — dino keaqar. Vehu haddin im ragil lomar tachanunim vesiyyem tachanunayv veamar acharehem "yihyu leratzon vego'", shebbaamirat pasuq zeh asa hessach haddaat millomar od tachanunim venishlema tepillato, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tk"b:
